description:
Motor insurance is mandate by law and a good insurance can save you in times of need. Be it online insurance portals or insurance companies like ICICI Lombard, HDFC ERGO, TATA AIG, NEW INDIA ASSURANCE or any other big insurance company, you can always claim a discount for your insurance. In this video we discuss different ways to reduce your insurance premium right from the basic IDV calculations, NCB, NCB transfer, online Quote matching, claim settlement ratio to other small yet important stuff in motor insurance. Importance of authorized service and linked garages along with insurance surveyors is also mentioned in this video.

BASICS OF INSURANCE: https://youtu.be/JF_0oBbjG-M

HOW TO CLAIM INSURANCE: https://youtu.be/bpacOnNAinQ

HAVE LOAN ON YOUR VEHICLE? Check this: https://youtu.be/YR-R1Eh3MQs

comments.text: @thesportztourer  site what's your opinion on using car 5w30 engine oil in Honda Aviator 2010
comments.author: @RamSharma-90_64

comments.text:
@RamSharma-90_64  not recommended because engine oil for cars and bikes are made for different purposes.   Using car oil in bikes may result to clutch slipping , overheating , damage to oil pump( if your bike has one ) and bad low/high temperature performance.  , Engine oil in bikes have multiple duties like .. cooling , gear oil , maintaining clutch friction.  Etc.  
( My own opinion )
